faqs.question: What does Dazzcode do?
faqs.answer: Dazzcode designs, builds, audits, deploys, and scales custom SaaS products, web applications, AI automation, and business software.

faqs.question: Does Dazzcode build custom SaaS products?
faqs.answer: Yes. Dazzcode engineers multi-tenant SaaS platforms with authentication, role-based access, billing integrations, and scalable database architecture.

faqs.question: Can Dazzcode build a SaaS MVP?
faqs.answer: Yes. Dazzcode scopes and delivers production-ready SaaS MVPs for founders validating new product ideas.

faqs.question: Does Dazzcode audit existing SaaS codebases?
faqs.answer: Yes. Code audits cover architecture, technical debt, security risks, database performance, and a prioritized remediation plan.

faqs.question: Does Dazzcode provide VPS deployment?
faqs.answer: Yes. Dazzcode deploys and operates Next.js, Node.js, and Docker applications on secure Linux VPS infrastructure with CI/CD and monitoring.

faqs.question: Can Dazzcode integrate AI automation into business workflows?
faqs.answer: Yes. Dazzcode builds AI-assisted workflows for lead qualification, CRM updates, document processing, and other operational processes.
